name: Qing Qiu
source: Matilda was saved from the space blockade in the middle of the circular city ruin. Tied to her waist is a peculiar looking weapon. The weapon looks like a whip but part of the handle is a grenade launcher. Since the launcher is pointed at her own face, it doesn't seem to be very safe. She is talkative and likes to have some light chats. She would not know what to do when the atmosphere is getting heavy.
